Name: Terrace Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
This Terrace Themed Map Replaces the Base Riverland Farm. 

Farm Notable Features

- 1446 Tiles of Terrace Farming that all counts for irrigation crops like Rice and Taro (all the tiles in the terrace area will waterlog)
- A Quarry that spawns ore like the Hilltop Farm does
- Forage that spawns in grassy area daily
- Respawning Stumps (only ones on grass, you can prevent it by putting something over it, like you normally would. a decoration, a floor, a building, whatever)
- Forest Farm's Weeds that always drop seeds will also spawn on the farm every day
- Riverland Farm's Normal Fish pool.

To install just unzip and drop in your stardew valley Mod Folder, which should have been created when you installed Smapi

Should Be Compatible with Any Recolor mods, as well as SVE (So far as any farm map is, aka I don't edit things outside the Farm map)

Some basic mods I'd like to recommend for this map are.[size=3]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6460]Waterproof Items
[/url][/size][url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10273514]Aquatic Plants
[/url][url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10296382]Beachside Plants[/url]
Always just a good mod to have really. and There is a lot of water, especially in the terrace area.
